title: Les théorèmes de M. Valiron sur les fonctions entières et la théorie de l'uniformisation
key_results: Proved the original Bloch theorem: every holomorphic function f on the unit disk with f'(0)=1 contains a schlicht disk of radius at least B >= 1/72. Established the existence of a universal constant B (the Bloch constant) as the supremum of radii of univalent disks in the image.
relevance_to_Bu: Foundational paper establishing the Bloch constant problem. The univalent Bloch constant B_u is a refinement where f is additionally required to be univalent on D. Bloch's original bound B >= 1/72 applies a fortiori to B_u.

title: Über die Blochsche Konstante und zwei verwandte Weltkonstanten
key_results: Systematized the framework distinguishing three constants: B (Bloch constant), L (Landau constant), and B_u (univalent Bloch constant, also called the schlicht Bloch constant). Proved B_u >= 1/2 using the Koebe 1/4-theorem applied to univalent functions.
relevance_to_Bu: First rigorous treatment of B_u as a distinct constant. The lower bound B_u >= 1/2 from the Koebe theorem remained the baseline for decades and set the stage for all subsequent improvements.

title: The Bloch constant A for a schlicht function
key_results: Refined the analysis of the schlicht Bloch constant (B_u). Provided detailed study of the extremal problem for univalent functions mapping the disk onto domains containing large schlicht disks.
relevance_to_Bu: Early refined analysis of B_u, building on Landau's framework. Confirmed B_u >= 1/2 with sharper methods and studied the structure of near-extremal functions.

title: Über die Blochsche Konstante
key_results: Conjectured the exact value of the Bloch constant B = Gamma(1/3)*Gamma(11/12) / (sqrt(1+sqrt(3)) * Gamma(1/4)) ≈ 0.4719. Proved the upper bound B <= 0.4719 by constructing an explicit Riemann surface showing no larger schlicht disk is universally guaranteed.
relevance_to_Bu: The Ahlfors-Grunsky upper bound on B provides context for B_u since B <= B_u (every univalent function is holomorphic). Their extremal construction methodology influenced all subsequent work on extremal domains for B_u.

title: An extension of Schwarz's lemma
key_results: Proved B >= sqrt(3)/4 ≈ 0.4330 using the theory of covering surfaces and an ultrahyperbolic metric argument. This remained the best lower bound on B for over 50 years.
relevance_to_Bu: Since B <= B_u, Ahlfors' lower bound B >= sqrt(3)/4 also gives B_u >= sqrt(3)/4. More importantly, his covering surface method became a key technique adapted in later work on B_u bounds.

title: On the Bloch-Landau constant for schlicht functions
key_results: Proposed that the extremal domains for B_u should be slit-disk domains—disks with radial slits removed. Analyzed the conformal mapping properties of such domains and their implications for the schlicht Bloch constant.
relevance_to_Bu: Directly targets B_u by proposing a candidate class of extremal domains. The slit-disk conjecture guided subsequent research on the geometry of extremal configurations for B_u, influencing Jenkins and Carroll's later work.

title: On a Bloch-Landau constant
key_results: Improved the lower bound on B_u above 1/2, obtaining B_u > 0.5 + epsilon for an explicit small epsilon. Used refined distortion estimates for univalent functions.
relevance_to_Bu: First improvement over Landau's 1929 baseline B_u >= 1/2. Demonstrated that the Koebe bound is not sharp for B_u and that further improvements are possible through more careful analysis.

title: On the schlicht Bloch constant / A criterion associated with the schlicht Bloch constant
key_results: Established necessary conditions that any extremal domain for B_u must satisfy, using the method of extremal metrics and quadratic differentials. The 1992 companion paper gave a precise criterion involving the Green's function and conformal modulus of the extremal configuration.
relevance_to_Bu: Central to the theoretical understanding of B_u. Jenkins' necessary conditions constrain the class of possible extremal domains, ruling out many candidate configurations. This work is foundational for Carroll's extensions and the Carroll-Ortega-Cerdà upper bound.

title: On the univalent Bloch constant
key_results: Established the best lower bound on B_u prior to Skinner's 2009 work: B_u >= 0.5705. Used variational methods and careful distortion estimates for univalent functions to push the lower bound significantly above 1/2.
relevance_to_Bu: Directly bounds B_u from below. The Beller-Hummel bound B_u >= 0.5705 was the state of the art for over two decades and provided a benchmark against which all subsequent lower bounds (Skinner 2009, Bhowmik-Schleissinger 2023) are measured.

title: On a variational problem of Chebotarev on the covering of a disk
key_results: Solved the Pólya-Chebotarev problem for four symmetrically placed points on the boundary of a disk. Determined the extremal configuration of branch points and slits that minimizes the conformal modulus of the covering.
relevance_to_Bu: The Pólya-Chebotarev problem is intimately connected to the Bloch constant problem, as extremal Bloch functions produce branched coverings. Fedorov's solution for symmetric configurations provides templates for understanding extremal domains relevant to B_u.

title: On Bloch's constant
key_results: Proved the first explicit improvement B > sqrt(3)/4 for the Bloch constant, breaking Ahlfors' 1938 bound using a distortion theorem for Bloch functions. Obtained B >= sqrt(3)/4 + 10^{-14}.
relevance_to_Bu: While targeting B rather than B_u directly, Bonk's distortion theorem techniques were adapted for the univalent setting. The breakthrough showed that Ahlfors' bound is not sharp, encouraging parallel efforts to improve B_u bounds.

title: Distortion theorems for locally univalent Bloch functions
key_results: Established distortion theorems specifically for locally univalent Bloch functions, providing sharp bounds on derivatives and related quantities. These estimates refine the classical distortion theorem in the Bloch function setting.
relevance_to_Bu: Directly relevant to B_u since univalent Bloch functions are a special case of locally univalent Bloch functions. The distortion estimates provide tools for bounding the size of schlicht disks in the image of univalent functions.

title: On Bloch's constant
key_results: Improved the lower bound on the Bloch constant to B > sqrt(3)/4 + 2*10^{-4} ≈ 0.4332, a significant quantitative improvement over Bonk's 1990 result.
relevance_to_Bu: Strengthens the lower bound on B, which in turn gives a better universal lower bound on B_u. The methods introduced, combining Ahlfors' covering surface theory with refined distortion estimates, influenced subsequent work on both B and B_u.

title: Distortion theorems for Bloch functions
key_results: Comprehensive treatment of distortion theorems for Bloch functions, extending and unifying earlier results. Established sharp bounds on |f'(z)|, |f''(z)|, and related quantities for normalized Bloch functions.
relevance_to_Bu: Highly cited (72+ citations) reference providing the distortion-theoretic toolkit used in modern approaches to both B and B_u. The sharp distortion bounds are essential inputs for the optimization arguments used in Skinner (2009) and Bhowmik-Schleissinger (2023).

title: Local minimality results related to the Bloch and Landau constants
key_results: Proved local minimality of the Ahlfors-Grunsky configuration for the Bloch constant problem. Showed that the conjectured extremal Riemann surface for B is a local minimum of the associated variational problem.
relevance_to_Bu: Provides deep structural insight into the Bloch constant variational problem. The local minimality techniques and the understanding of the variational landscape inform analogous investigations for B_u, particularly regarding the structure of extremal univalent maps.

title: On the schlicht Bloch constant II
key_results: Extended the analysis of extremal domains for B_u from the 1961 paper. Refined the necessary conditions on extremal configurations, providing sharper constraints on the geometry of slit structures in candidate extremal domains.
relevance_to_Bu: Directly targets B_u. The refined necessary conditions narrow the search space for extremal domains and inform both the upper bound constructions (Carroll-Ortega-Cerdà) and the lower bound approaches (Skinner, Bhowmik-Schleissinger).

title: Bloch constants for planar harmonic mappings
key_results: Extended the Bloch constant problem to the setting of planar harmonic mappings, establishing analogues of the Bloch and Landau constants. Proved existence of universal covering disks for harmonic mappings satisfying appropriate normalizations.
relevance_to_Bu: Extends the Bloch constant framework to a broader class of mappings. While not directly bounding B_u, the harmonic mapping perspective reveals structural aspects of the problem and connects to the recent work of Bhowmik-Sen (2024) on elliptic harmonic Bloch constants.

title: Bloch functions and Bloch constants
key_results: Improved the lower bound on the Bloch constant to B >= sqrt(3)/4 + 3*10^{-4} ≈ 0.4333. Refined the distortion theorem approach with tighter estimates on the covering radius.
relevance_to_Bu: Further improves the universal lower bound on B, which applies to B_u as well. The refined distortion estimates and covering arguments contribute to the technical toolkit used in bounding B_u from below.

title: On the locally univalent Bloch constant
key_results: Studied the Bloch constant restricted to locally univalent functions (functions with non-vanishing derivative). Established bounds on this intermediate constant that lies between B and B_u.
relevance_to_Bu: The locally univalent Bloch constant is an intermediate quantity between B and B_u, providing a bridge between the two problems. Bounds on this constant give indirect information about B_u and illuminate the role of univalence in the Bloch constant hierarchy.

title: Conformal welding and Koebe's theorem
key_results: Developed new techniques connecting conformal welding to Koebe's theorem and quasiconformal mappings. Provided constructive approaches to conformal mapping problems using quasiconformal decompositions.
relevance_to_Bu: Bridges the Bloch constant problem to quasiconformal theory. The conformal welding perspective offers alternative approaches to constructing and analyzing extremal functions for B_u, and connects to modern computational methods for conformal mapping.

title: Extension of Jenkins' condition for extremal domains associated with the univalent Bloch constant
key_results: Extended Jenkins' necessary conditions for extremal domains of B_u. Proved additional geometric and analytic constraints that any extremal configuration must satisfy, using refined quadratic differential methods.
relevance_to_Bu: Directly targets B_u by strengthening the necessary conditions on extremal domains. Carroll's extensions are used in the Carroll-Ortega-Cerdà (2009) paper to establish the best known upper bound on B_u.

title: The univalent Bloch-Landau constant, harmonic symmetry, and conformal glueing
key_results: Established the best known upper bound B_u <= 0.6564 by constructing explicit candidate extremal domains using harmonic symmetry and conformal glueing techniques. Analyzed slit-disk configurations satisfying Jenkins-Carroll necessary conditions.
relevance_to_Bu: Provides the current best upper bound on B_u. Combined with the Bhowmik-Schleissinger (2023) lower bound B_u >= 0.5708, this gives the tightest known interval 0.5708 <= B_u <= 0.6564. The extremal domain constructions are essential targets for any computational verification.

title: Inverse function theorem and its applications to the theory of holomorphic self-maps of the disk
key_results: Developed inverse function theorem techniques for holomorphic self-maps of the disk, providing new estimates on injectivity radii and covering properties of conformal mappings.
relevance_to_Bu: The injectivity radius estimates connect to the Bloch constant problem, as B_u measures the guaranteed injectivity disk radius for normalized univalent functions. The inverse function theorem perspective offers alternative pathways to bounding B_u.

title: Landau-type theorem and Bloch constant for elliptic harmonic mappings
key_results: Established Landau-type theorems and Bloch constant analogues for elliptic harmonic mappings, a generalization of both holomorphic and planar harmonic mappings. Proved existence of schlicht disks with explicit radius bounds.
relevance_to_Bu: Extends the B_u problem to the elliptic harmonic setting, generalizing Chen-Gauthier-Hengartner (2000). While the elliptic harmonic Bloch constant differs from B_u, the techniques and structural insights may inform new approaches to the classical B_u problem.
